reviewer: root with explicit research_review and baseline_review adjudication
scope: One fixed native compact prior and ordinary q/v learning qualification; a baseline/control role, not a proposed new framework.
research_question: Can an intact jointly pretrained compact vision-connector-language graph carry the common raw QA tasks and finite-budget continual learning, where the previously spliced compact graph did not reach the full parent's domain floors?
evidence_for_necessity: Verified compact spliced graph with all-position allocation reached macro39.262041796 below full wide43.791987409; it did not test an intact native backbone.
Previous native initial check failed in processor.resize before generate; old Q training was never executed. Those are missing quality rather than evidence against native capacity.
A successful qualification changes the carrier baseline for subsequent mechanism design; a failure closes this fixed recipe and prevents assigning the existing model's parameter saving to our method.
transparent_revision: Reopens the old unexecuted Q control role under one fixed FP16/GPUAdamW condition; old BF16/Host-Q and technical failures stay preserved. No E/R reopening, no claim of exact reproduction or a new hypothesis.
rule029_adjudication: Both subagents explicitly accepted a structural qualification with fixed common FP16, no BF16 comparison or fallback, no precision/backend sweep and no precision-gain contribution. Numerical condition is disclosed rather than treated as a research axis.
GPU_policy: All model forward/backward/optimizer/fold on a genuinely empty OLD GPU. CPU only ordinary preprocessing, tensor/checkpoint I/O, hashes and scoring. No new synthetic model gate is required by the reused standard LoRA operator.
known_technique_credit: Native compact architecture, joint pretrained prior and parameter saving belong to SmolVLM authors; ordinary LoRA learning is a baseline. No novelty is claimed here.
decision_relevance: Only a complete trajectory with every historical parent-domain point floor, smaller complete deployment package and all five same-card GPU allocated peaks lower retains Q as a carrier/learning baseline. No initial-score-dependent branch.
limits: One explored DEV split and seed,20 QA/domain; no significance or formal strongest-baseline conclusion.
Backbone/pretraining/tokenizer/vision interfaces differ and native eager versus parent SDPA is explicit; not a causal isolation of joint prior.
Historical parent43.79 is reused through sealed proof; the new parent5 resource windows do not re-establish that score for the freshly loaded graph.
All four phases use fresh model payloads within one CUDA context; library workspace residue is recorded, not asserted to be zero.
